No material business acquisitions are reported for FY2022 or FY2021 in Note 5.","answer":"For fiscal year 2023, Amcor completed the following acquisitions (all within the Flexibles reportable segment):
1. On August 1, 2022, 100% equity interest in a Czech Republic company operating a flexible packaging manufacturing plant, with a purchase consideration of $59 million.
2. On March 17, 2023, 100% equity interest in a medical device packaging manufacturing site in Shanghai, China, with a purchase consideration of $60 million.
3. On May 31, 2023, a New Zealand-based manufacturer of automated protein packaging machines, with a purchase consideration of $45 million.

For fiscal years 2022 and 2021, Amcor's 10-K notes do not report any major business acquisitions under Note 5 (Acquisitions and Divestitures), focusing instead on divestitures, portfolio optimization, and restructuring activities (such as the disposal of non-core businesses in India and Argentina and the sale of the AMVIG equity investment in FY2021).","needs_review":false,"confidence":1}
